title: Cerebellar Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation (tDCS) in Children With Autism Spectrum Disorder: Raynor Cerebellum Project
official: Right Lateralized Posterior Cerebellar tDCS in Children With Autism Spectrum Disorder
summary: The purpose of this research study is to investigate the effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) on some of the challenges faced by children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages 5 to 21, male and female, with known autism spectrum disorder as diagnosed by a clinician

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Brain implants
* Pacemakers
* Any biomedical or metal implants in any part of body
* Hearing or visual impairment
* History of brain injury
* Known brain or skull abnormality other than those that may be associated with ASD
sponsor: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center
